<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Flowcatalyst\Events\Platform\Iam\User;

final readonly class UserCreatedData
{
    public function __construct(
        public bool $enabled,
        public ?bool $maybe,
        public string $alwaysTrue,
        public ?string $alwaysFalse,
        public mixed $nothing,
        public ?array $flags,
    ) {}

    /** @param array<string, mixed> $data */
    public static function fromArray(array $data): self
    {
        return new self(
            enabled: $data['enabled'],
            maybe: $data['maybe'],
            alwaysTrue: $data['alwaysTrue'],
            alwaysFalse: $data['alwaysFalse'],
            nothing: $data['nothing'],
            flags: $data['flags'],
        );
    }

    /** @return array<string, mixed> */
    public function toArray(): array
    {
        return [
            'enabled' => $this->enabled,
            'maybe' => $this->maybe,
            'alwaysTrue' => $this->alwaysTrue,
            'alwaysFalse' => $this->alwaysFalse,
            'nothing' => $this->nothing,
            'flags' => $this->flags,
        ];
    }
}
